title: Theoretical insights of silicene doped with transition metals as C – reactive protein biosensors for cardiac vascular applications using density functional theory
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15662-15673
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06649B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kalpana Devi P, Aiswarya T, K. K. Singh, Vilas H. Gaidhane, Neeru Sood
Iron-doped silicene is proposed as an efficient platform for C-reactive protein (CRP) detection. DFT calculations reveal strong adsorption, significant charge transfer, and notable electronic structure modulation, enabling rapid and sensitive CRP sensing for next-generation biosensor applications.
